query: Vilka avtal undantar brott mot sekretess från ansvarsbegränsningen?
classify_question: Innehåller texten att ansvarsbegränsningen inte gäller vid brott mot sekretess?
notes: Passage gold is an operative carve-out of confidentiality breach from a liability cap. A cap that only carves out intent, gross negligence, GDPR/PUB or a numbered cross-reference is not passage-relevant. Document gold is the contract that contains such a carve-out. Avtal 46 splits the cap and the carve-out; coverage_groups records that both must be found for the document-level conclusion. Corrected after C@8: Avtal 30 and 36 were genuine carve-outs omitted from the first gold.
